result.summary: The page appears visually consistent and well-structured overall. However, there is a minor layout issue where the 'Trattoria Piccol...' text is truncated, and a minor content issue regarding the notification badge on the bell icon which might be confusing.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated at the edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Consider allowing the text to wrap to a second line or adjust the card width to accommodate full names, or ensure truncation includes an ellipsis clearly indicating more text.

issues.description: The notification bell icon has a red dot indicating unread notifications, but there is no visible count or clear indication of what the notification is for.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a notification count badge or ensuring the notification center is easily accessible and clearly explains the alert.
